project.description:
The one gloss collection the classpath offers: the hand-curated set read OVER the machine-seeded one.
This is the only module allowed to depend on both, and the only one that registers a ZiCollection. kranji-gloss and kranji-gloss-seed no longer register themselves - they are data, and this decides how the data stacks.
LAYERED PER (CHARACTER, READING), not per character. The composition underneath shadows a whole character when two sources both have it, so a curated gloss of 把 at ba3 used to take the seed's ba4 down with it. That was invisible while the seed held monophones only, and stops being invisible the moment a reading is curated on its own.
THE COST, STATED: dropping kranji-gloss-seed now breaks this module rather than degrading it, because the dependency is a compile-time one. Which layers a build has is a pom edit, not a fact about the classpath.
